description: The plot illustrates counts for five categories (Type1, Type2, Type3, RR, WW) grouped by model. The x-axis is labeled “Model” on a categorical scale with two groups: “Llama 3 8B” and “Mistral 7B.” The y-axis is labeled “Count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120 with regularly spaced tick marks every 20 units. For “Llama 3 8B,” the bars show Type1 as a teal bar at about 15, Type2 as an orange bar at about 25, Type3 as a bluish-gray bar slightly below zero (around −10), RR as a pink bar near 122, and WW as a light green bar near 35. For “Mistral 7B,” Type1 (teal) is near 29, Type2 (orange) is near 26, Type3 (bluish-gray) is at 0 (no visible height), RR (pink) is near 114, and WW (light green) is near 31; all bars are solid fills with no markers or line styles since this is a grouped bar chart.
